revisedScope.reason: Published 0.67 treats TypeError from main-frame structural validation as terminal; positive qualification retains that counterexample.

changes: Explicit revised positive scope retains the initial failed structural-input capture.
Only the two declared nonrecoverable main-frame checks are excluded from the seven recoverable cases.
Authenticated graph blobs are hydrated before the unchanged ticket, graph, acquisition and physical-return assertions.

limitations: Retained public presentations use zero padding from the original small component corpus to 64x64; the model limit changes from 14 to 32.
The reader validates actual recorded public RPCs and authoritative graph deltas. It never starts a runtime, worker, game or oracle.
Retained graph state and the ensuing questions are checked; internal restore method calls are not observed by this capture.
The final authorized question is inspected and closed without dispatch. A finished BranchRouting owner does not constrain every other native owner.
Node interthread environment adaptation is not a browser DOM, HTTP/CSP, real-game, complete-parity or performance qualification.
Previously instrumented native incomplete-acquisition evidence is not reclassified as an ordinary public-worker run.
The initial nine-recoverable-error scope failed on a 63-row main frame. It stays failed; v2 qualifies only seven recoverable refusals and the three positive sessions.
Malformed main-frame dimensions and palette are excluded from recovery qualification. The production exception policy is unchanged.
Repeated KnowledgeMemory values are stored once by SHA256 in gzip blobs. Compressed/raw bytes and lengths are verified before the original full graph is validated.

codeBasis.rule: validateV6PublicObservation calls toV6PublicObservation; toAgentObservation runs before publicFrame.
A wrong main-frame shape or palette throws TypeError in toAgentObservation.
The catch closes the pending authority for non-V6AgentError exceptions, including pre-backend TypeError.
Non-V6AgentError exceptions are reported as internal; subsequent resume is stale.
Existing recoverable-packet cases cover ticket/session/sequence/timing/animation/extra-field errors, not main-frame shape or palette.
